# Work Item Plan

## Work Item WI-001: 后端关卡服务与数据契约

### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: 后端关卡服务与数据契约
- kind: backend

### Goal
- summary: WHEN 服务启动 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过 Node 内置模块提供五项关卡数据 API 与可配置静态资源托管。

### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法逻辑。
- non_goals: 不实现或依赖前端渲染行为。
- non_goals: 不引入 npm 依赖、数据库、认证或外部服务。

### Dependencies
- depends_on: []

### Inputs

### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- capabilities: `createServer(options)` accepts `dataPath` and `staticRoot`
- capabilities: `start({ port })` returns Promise resolving `{ origin, port, stop }`
- capabilities: `origin` is `http://127.0.0.1:<actual port>` and `port: 0` is supported
- capabilities: `stop()` returns Promise
- capabilities: `GET /api/levels` returns `200 OK` with a top-level array of exactly 5 levels
- capabilities: level `id` is a non-empty unique string
- capabilities: level `name` is a non-empty string
- capabilities: level `difficulty` is exactly one of `简单` `普通` `困难`
- capabilities: level `unlocked` is boolean
- capabilities: missing unreadable invalid JSON or invalid level data returns `500 Internal Server Error` with `LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE` and a readable message
- capabilities: unknown API path returns `404 Not Found` JSON error object with `code` and `message`
- capabilities: unsupported API method returns `405 Method Not Allowed` JSON error object with `code` and `message`
- capabilities: API success and error responses use `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`
- capabilities: static hosting resolves configured `staticRoot` safely with normalized absolute paths
- capabilities: `GET /` returns the configured static entry resource
- capabilities: missing static resource returns a `404 Not Found` text response
- capabilities: API success and error responses use `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`
- capabilities: missing static resource returns a `404 Not Found` text response

### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN 后端数据初始化 THE SYSTEM SHALL 创建恰好包含五项合法字段的 `data/levels.json`。
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN 后端实现开始前 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 `tests/backend/` 编写服务生命周期、API 成功、数据错误、路由错误与静态托管的失败测试。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-004, NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-001, AC-002, AC-003, AC-004, AC-005
- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN 生命周期测试存在 THE SYSTEM SHALL 实现 `createServer(options)` 与 `start({ port })` 并支持临时端口和 Promise 停止。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN API 测试存在 THE SYSTEM SHALL 读取并校验静态 JSON 后返回五项关卡或统一 JSON 错误响应。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002, REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-002, AC-003, AC-004
- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN 静态托管测试存在 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用规范化绝对路径安全返回配置静态目录中的资源并对缺失资源返回文本 404。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-005

### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: `server/**`
- exclusive_scopes: `data/levels.json`
- exclusive_scopes: `tests/backend/**`
- forbidden_scopes: `web/**`
- forbidden_scopes: `tests/frontend/**`
- forbidden_scopes: `tests/integration/**`
- forbidden_scopes: npm dependencies
- forbidden_scopes: gameplay logic

### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN 测试以 `port: 0` 启动服务 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回实际 `origin`、实际 `port` 和可等待的 `stop()`。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN `GET /api/levels` 成功 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 200 和包含恰好五项且 `id`、`name`、`difficulty`、`unlocked` 全部合法的顶层数组。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-003
- statement: WHEN 数据文件缺失、不可读、JSON 无效或结构无效 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 500、JSON 错误结构和 `LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE`。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-004
- statement: WHEN API 路径未知或方法不支持 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回对应 404 或 405 的统一 JSON 错误响应。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-005
- statement: WHEN 请求配置静态目录资源 THE SYSTEM SHALL 安全解析路径、返回入口资源或对缺失资源返回文本 404。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution

### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: `node --test tests/backend/`
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true

- required_fields: contract_id, capabilities, verification_command, verification_result

- reviewer_check_refs: AC-005

## Work Item WI-002: 原生关卡选择页

### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: 原生关卡选择页
- kind: frontend

### Goal
- summary: WHEN 用户打开关卡选择页 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用原生页面脚本渲染关卡名称、难度与锁定态并在失败时保留可读错误提示。

### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不修改后端实现或后端测试。
- non_goals: 不启动浏览器或引入浏览器自动化。
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法逻辑。

### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001

### Inputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: `GET /api/levels` returns `200 OK` with a top-level array of exactly 5 levels
- required_capabilities: level `id` is a non-empty unique string
- required_capabilities: level `name` is a non-empty string
- required_capabilities: level `difficulty` is exactly one of `简单` `普通` `困难`
- required_capabilities: level `unlocked` is boolean
- required_capabilities: missing unreadable invalid JSON or invalid level data returns `500 Internal Server Error` with `LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE` and a readable message
- required_capabilities: unknown API path returns `404 Not Found` JSON error object with `code` and `message`
- required_capabilities: unsupported API method returns `405 Method Not Allowed` JSON error object with `code` and `message`
- required_capabilities: API success and error responses use `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`
- compatibility_policy: require_all

### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-002
- capabilities: `web/index.html` contains `id=loading`, `id=level-list`, `id=error-message` and loads `web/level-select.js`
- capabilities: `web/level-select.js` exports `initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl })`
- capabilities: `initLevelSelect` shows loading then renders every valid level name and difficulty using safe text nodes
- capabilities: `initLevelSelect` renders `unlocked=false` as locked and not selectable
- capabilities: `initLevelSelect` validates the API array and all four field constraints before rendering
- capabilities: fetch failure non-success response or invalid response shape enters a readable error branch while retaining the page skeleton
- capabilities: `web/level-select.js` references `/api/levels`

### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN 前端实现开始前 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 `tests/frontend/` 使用最小 document 与可注入 fetch 替身编写页面结构、成功渲染、锁定态和失败分支的失败测试。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005, REQ-006, NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-006, AC-007, AC-008
- task_id: TASK-007
- statement: WHEN 页面结构测试存在 THE SYSTEM SHALL 创建包含加载、列表、错误容器并引入 `web/level-select.js` 的 `web/index.html`。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-006
- task_id: TASK-008
- statement: WHEN 渲染测试存在 THE SYSTEM SHALL 实现可注入 DOM 与 fetch 的 `initLevelSelect` 并安全渲染名称、难度和锁定态。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-007
- task_id: TASK-009
- statement: WHEN 响应缺失、非成功、结构无效或字段无效 THE SYSTEM SHALL 保留页面骨架并展示可读错误提示。
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-008

### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: `web/**`
- exclusive_scopes: `tests/frontend/**`
- forbidden_scopes: `server/**`
- forbidden_scopes: `data/levels.json`
- forbidden_scopes: `tests/backend/**`
- forbidden_scopes: `tests/integration/**`
- forbidden_scopes: npm dependencies
- forbidden_scopes: browser automation
- forbidden_scopes: gameplay logic

### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-006
- statement: WHEN 检查页面入口 THE SYSTEM SHALL 确认三个容器标记存在且页面加载 `web/level-select.js`。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-007
- statement: WHEN 注入 fetch 返回合法五项数组 THE SYSTEM SHALL 渲染全部名称与难度并将 `unlocked=false` 显示为锁定且不可选择。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-008
- statement: WHEN 注入 fetch 失败、返回非成功状态或无效结构 THE SYSTEM SHALL 进入可读错误分支且页面骨架不消失。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution

### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: `node --test tests/frontend/`
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true

- required_fields: contract_id, capabilities, verification_command, verification_result

- reviewer_check_refs: AC-007
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-008
